title: State Migration
scope: Covers Census vintage state population estimates, domestic and international migration, births, and deaths, USDA 2023 rural-urban continuum codes (share of 2020 county population in metro RUCC 1-3 counties), and Census vintage 2025 age and race shares (including age 65 and over, age 17 and under, Hispanic or Latino, and White non-Hispanic).
exclusions: Does not cover IRS taxpayer migration (that is Taxpayer Migration) or municipal populations (that is Massachusetts Town Profiles).
heritage: Formerly Population Change, Domestic Migration, US Demographics, and Rural to Urban
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from Census vintage 2025 NST-EST2025-ALLDATA. Population is POPESTIMATE2025 (July 1). The ranking is DOMESTICMIG2025, not total population. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Tableau companions compiled Aug 16, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Domestic and international migration, births, deaths, population change, and age and race shares by state.
lead: The Census vintage 2025 estimate put the United States at 341,784,857 on July 1, 2025 (SRC-617-01). Massachusetts was 7,154,084, with domestic migration of -33,340, rank 47 of 51 (derived, SRC-617-01). Under the 2023 USDA rural-urban continuum codes, 98.5% of Massachusetts 2020 county population lived in metro (RUCC 1-3) counties (SRC-617-02). The state has 11 metro counties and 3 nonmetro counties (SRC-617-02). 19.9% of Massachusetts residents were 65 and over in 2025, rank 21 of 51 (derived, SRC-617-03). Census estimated 68,055 births and 59,636 deaths in Massachusetts in 2025 (SRC-617-01).
